rationale: The strongest candidates are earlier veto memoranda that share the general pattern of acknowledging a measure's sympathetic purpose, identifying a fatal defect, defending an established federal policy, and suggesting better legislation. But those similarities are conventional veto-message organization rather than distinctive language or materially parallel legal machinery. C23 also mentions hasty passage without adequate consideration, but its social-assistance analysis and proposed remedy do not map concretely onto the child's objection to federally mandated school segregation. C13 and C16 are still more remote. No displayed candidate plausibly supplied a concrete, material drafting template.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The basic purpose of this bill is meritorious. ... Unfortunately, however, the Congress has included one provision in this bill which I cannot approve.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Naturally everyone has a genuine concern for the plight of blind persons ... From a superficial point of view this bill might seem to be of benefit ... However, a thoughtful examination of the bill leads to the conclusion...
shared_material.explanation: C23 uses the common veto-message move of recognizing a worthy apparent purpose before explaining a decisive objection, but the wording and substantive analysis are not sufficiently distinctive.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The objectionable provision was added during the closing days of the first session without the careful consideration necessary...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The bill was introduced and passed in the closing hours of the recent session. No public hearings were held...
shared_material.explanation: C23 contains the closest specific rhetorical parallel: criticism of last-minute enactment without adequate consideration. This isolated similarity does not establish a material drafting template for the rest of the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hope the Congress early in the next session will reconsider this matter carefully and will re-enact legislation ... without the objectionable provision...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hope that the Congress will consider legislation ... under carefully-worked out standards ... without doing violence to the basic and often re-affirmed principle...
shared_material.explanation: C13 similarly closes by urging alternative legislation that addresses a legitimate need without compromising an established policy, but this is a generic remedial conclusion and involves different legal machinery.
